decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic extension in the firm’s core organic yogurt range that remained marketed through 2024, it fits the strategy closely and now looks sufficiently validated to keep.

This mild sliced cheese is a low-risk line extension of existing cheesemaking capabilities, so under real-options logic it is worth keeping while the still-new product’s market potential becomes clearer.

This sliced butter cheese also sits close to the established offer, but because it is a very recent launch in a broad portfolio with some overlap to other cheese options, its chance of rationalization is somewhat higher even though it should still be kept for now.
